title: Handoff note
description: The YAML in the `aidd-handoff` block a role ends each run with (references/handoff.md). It is a report from an agent, so it is data: never a person's yes, and never evidence. `aidd validate` warns about a note that breaks this shape, and about hidden characters or text posing as a person's words in it. It advises and blocks nothing. The latest note in a document counts. `next` is checked against the roles in roles.json and `status` against the Spec statuses, because those lists have their own owners.

done.description: What the run did, with the evidence it names. Debt found and left goes here as `debt: <what, where>`.

next.description: The role that takes the work next, such as `verifier`. A role, never an approval and never a person's decision.

needs.description: A decision only a person can give, in one sentence, or `none`. A choice between options points to a decision card.

stopped_at.description: The stop rule that fired, or `none`. In a headless run, the `ask` it reached.

spend.description: Tokens or cost of the run.

status.description: The Spec status the run stopped in (`aidd status` shows it): one of the Spec statuses.

asked.description: What a person asked the role directly, and what the role did with it.

decided.description: What the role settled itself, each with what settled it.
